Чародейка приходила в кузню. Огненные во: The sorceress came to the forge. Fiery hair, eyes like embers. She said that if a strong enough fire were lit here, it would become a new sun, and it would push the black one away. She asks for lava. A lot of lava. We dig channels day and night.
Чародейку звали Илара. Она хотела зажечь: The sorceress's name was Ilara. She wanted to light a new sun and save everyone at once. Her fire now burns below forever, and she with it — neither dead nor alive, angry at everyone who can still go up.

Это всё ещё Олдрик. Король костей пал, н: It's still Oldric. The Bone King fell, but the Eclipse did not let him go: it wanted more, it wanted to wring the last of the gravedigger's strength. His bones were burned — and the dark fanned the ashes into a fiery king. His blade glows hot with his own pain. If he falls a second time, the Eclipse will have nothing left to shield itself with. The way to it will open.
Я был могильщиком. Потом — Королём косте: I was a gravedigger. Then the Bone King. They killed me, and I thought I would finally lie in the earth. But the sun below does not let its own go. It wrings the strength out of me like water from a rag, and every drop burns. Now I am ash in a crown. And the ash remembers everyone who buried me.
Я поняла. Грибы растут не на земле — на: I understand now. The mushrooms don't grow on soil — they grow on the light that falls down. The Eclipse didn't cover the sun. It ate it, and now the light drains underground, toward something hungry. The mushrooms are just crumbs from its table.
The queen viper's venom has no antidote.
